General Notes for the Statement:
1.The value of the related party transaction approved by the audit committee represents the value approved by audit committee of the Company or the subsidiary, as the case may be. The value of the related party transaction approved by the audit committee is shown as '0' for transactions where approval of audit committee is not applicable as per Regulation 23 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 or for transactions by subsidiary(ies) which are not required to constitute audit committee or for transactions of subsidiaries with parties which are not related party of concerned subsidiary.
2.Retail purchases by related parties from the companies in the group and payment for availment of telecom services as a subscriber from the companies in the group are not disclosed.
3.Details pertaining to foreign subsidiaries are for the period up to December 31, 2025.
4.The value of transaction represents the value of transaction with related party from the date the party became related party. The opening / closing balances include the amounts due to / due from the party before the party became related party.
5.The opening / closing balances include the amount of applicable taxes, while the transaction value excludes the applicable taxes.
6.Amounts between Rs. 50,00,000 and Rs. 99,99,999 have been rounded up and shown as Rs. 1 crore and amounts less than Rs. 50,00,000 have been rounded down and shown as Rs. 0 crore.
7.The closing balance of debentures includes debentures issued on rights issue basis during the half year.
8.In terms of a scheme of arrangement, erstwhile Reliance Consumer Products Limited (Old RCPL) amalgamated with Reliance Retail Ventures Limited (RRVL) and FMCG Brands Business Undertaking of Reliance Retail Limited (RRL) stood transferred to RRVL with appointed date of April 1, 2025. Accordingly, transactions of the Company / its subsidiaries with Old RCPL / pertaining to FMCG Brands Business Undertaking of RRL disclosed at sr. nos. 338, 1140, 1646, 1706, 1744, 1753, 1754 and 1755 are shown as transactions with RRVL.
9.In terms of a scheme of arrangement, Reliance Electrolyser Manufacturing Limited, Reliance Green Hydrogen and Green Chemicals Limited, Reliance Petro Materials Limited and Reliance Power Electronics Limited amalgamated with Reliance New Energy Limited (RNEL), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company with the appointed date of opening business hours of October 01, 2025. Accordingly, the transactions / balances of the Company with these subsidiaries disclosed at sr. nos. 301 to 307 are shown as transactions / balances with RNEL.
10.In terms of a scheme of arrangement, IndiaCast Media Distribution Private Limited (Indiacast) amalgamated with Jiostar India Private Limited (Jiostar) with the appointed date of opening business hours of April 1, 2025 (Scheme). Accordingly, the transactions / balances with Indiacast disclosed at sr nos. 713, 923, 1173, 1189, 1194, 1196, 1199, 1205, 1206 and 1221 are shown as transactions/ balances with Jiostar.
